highlights: AI agents are rapidly maturing with new enterprise platforms from OpenAI and enhanced developer tools from Google, enabling builders to deploy robust, production-ready agentic workflows for specialized tasks like autonomous test management.

Significant breakthroughs in LLM inference optimization are delivering unprecedented speedups for models like dLLMs (up to 105x) and improving sampling efficiency, while new benchmarks drive autonomous kernel optimization and agent-driven inference improvements.

Leading AI companies are strategically expanding into high-value sectors, notably healthcare with ChatGPT's new medical record integration and Google's validated medical AI, alongside targeted programs to empower small businesses and integrate AI more deeply into core products.

agents.title: AINTMA: Agentic AI for Autonomous Test Management
agents.summary: This new multi-agent AI architecture transforms software quality assurance into an autonomous intelligence ecosystem, deploying specialized agents for test discovery, risk assessment, and generative quality narratives, demonstrating significant ROI and efficiency gains.

agents.title: Introducing OpenAI Presence for Enterprise
agents.summary: OpenAI has launched Presence, a dedicated enterprise AI agent platform designed to help organizations securely deploy trusted voice and chat agents for critical customer and internal workflows.

agents.title: Expanding Managed Agents in Gemini API
agents.summary: Google is enhancing Managed Agents in Gemini API with new capabilities like background tasks and remote Multi-agent Control Plane (MCP), empowering developers to build more reliable and production-ready AI agents.

models.title: DC-Leap: Training-Free Acceleration of dLLMs
models.summary: DC-Leap is a training-free framework that achieves substantial speedups (up to 105x) for Diffusion Large Language Models (dLLMs) without compromising quality, through a dynamic contiguous verification strategy and draft-guided decoding.

models.title: Robust Critics: Defending LLMs Against Multi-Turn Attacks
models.summary: This framework, Dialogue Critic Guided Sampling (DCGS), infers user intent at every turn of dialogue to robustly defend LLMs against multi-turn attacks by learning value and regret-based critics, outperforming existing safety baselines.

models.title: Google's AMIE Medical AI for Health Conditions
models.summary: New research published in 'Nature' validates Google's conversational AI system, AMIE, demonstrating its capability to match primary care physicians in complex disease management, opening new avenues for medical AI applications.

tools.title: JAXBench: Benchmarking Autonomous TPU Kernel Optimization
tools.summary: JAXBench is a new TPU-native benchmark suite comprising 50 JAX workloads, designed to drive progress in autonomous AI-generated kernel optimization on Google Cloud TPUs and support open-source contributions.

tools.title: SonicSampler: Unified Kernels for LLM Sampling and Speculative Verification
tools.summary: SonicSampler introduces unified, tile-aware Triton kernels that vertically fuse the complete LLM sampling pipeline, achieving up to 16x speedup over state-of-the-art baselines for heterogeneous speculative decoding workloads.

tools.title: InferenceBench: Benchmark for LLM Inference Optimization by AI Agents
tools.summary: InferenceBench is a new benchmark for evaluating AI agents on open-ended LLM inference optimization tasks, revealing that current agents can improve performance significantly but still fall short of systematic hyperparameter search.

companies.title: Launching Health in ChatGPT with Record Integration
companies.summary: OpenAI has launched 'Health in ChatGPT' for eligible U.S. users, allowing secure connection of medical records and Apple Health data to provide personalized health insights and enhance understanding of medical information.

companies.title: Introducing ChatGPT for Small Business Program
companies.summary: OpenAI launched a new program dedicated to small businesses, aiming to help entrepreneurs build AI skills, automate workflows, and leverage ChatGPT Work for growth.

companies.title: Connect More Apps to Google Search AI Mode
companies.summary: Google is expanding its Search platform to allow users to securely link and interact with their favorite services directly within AI Mode, significantly enhancing the utility and integration of AI-powered search.

learning.title: A Scorecard for the AI Age by OpenAI CFO
learning.summary: OpenAI's CFO, Sarah Friar, introduced a practical AI scorecard to help businesses measure Return on Investment (ROI) from AI, focusing on metrics like useful work, cost per successful task, and dependability.

learning.title: Lessons Learned from Building Shippy Agents
learning.summary: Hugging Face shared valuable insights and practical lessons gleaned from building 'Shippy,' offering guidance for developers and researchers working on constructing and deploying AI agents.

learning.title: Profiling in PyTorch (Part 3): Attention is All You Profile
learning.summary: This guide, part of a series on PyTorch profiling, focuses on optimizing attention mechanisms, providing essential knowledge for developers looking to enhance the performance of their AI models.
